title: Crestline Credit Card Fee Schedule: Late, Returned Payment and Courtesy Figures
content:
The Crestline Credit Card charges no over-limit fee: a purchase that would take the balance above the credit limit is declined at authorization and never posts. The fees the card does charge for a missed minimum or a returned payment are the same on every product; the courtesy late-fee allowance differs by product.

## Fee figures

| Figure | Every product |
|---|---|
| Late fee, first | 30 USD (30.0) |
| Late fee, repeat | 41 USD (41.0) |
| Look-back for a repeat | 6 billing cycles |
| Late fee cap | never more than the minimum payment due on the statement |
| Returned payment fee, first | 30 USD (30.0) |
| Returned payment fee, repeat | 41 USD (41.0) |
| Over-limit purchase | declined at authorization; no fee |
| Courtesy waiver needs the missed minimum paid in full | Yes |

| Product | Courtesy late-fee waivers in any rolling 12 months |
|---|---|
| Crestline Auto Care Card Starter | 0 |
| Crestline Auto Care Card | 1 |
| Crestline Auto Care Card Preferred | 1 |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard | 1 |
| Crestline Auto Care Mastercard Preferred | 1 |
| Crestline Auto Care World Mastercard | 2 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. A late fee is the **first** amount when no late fee was charged in the previous 6 billing cycles and the **repeat** amount when another late fee was charged within them.
2. A returned payment fee is the **first** amount when none was charged in the previous 6 cycles and the **repeat** amount when another was charged within them.
3. The late fee cap is the minimum payment due on that statement. Hypothetical case: on a statement whose minimum due was 25.00 USD, a fee that would otherwise be 30 USD is capped at 25.00 USD.
4. The courtesy allowance is a count of late fees that may be reversed as a courtesy in any rolling 12 months; an allowance of 0 means no courtesy reversal on that product.
